2,147 likes, 4 comments - foodeanie on July 13, 2026: "Korean Popcorn Chicken🍗👨‍🍳

Ingredients:
Chicken Breast 
2x egg
Cornflakes
1tbsp Paprika
1tbsp Chilli Powder
1tbsp Garlic Powder
1tbsp Ground Ginger

Sauce:
1.5tbsp Gochujang 
2tbsp Soy Sauce
1tsp rice wine vinegar 
2tsp mirin
3tbsp honey
(this is enough for one medium chicken breast, adjust accordingly)

Instructions:
Cut your chicken breast into bite size pieces
Coat your chicken in the seasonings listed above
Now dip your chicken in the egg, then immediately coating in cornflakes.
Once done place in the air fryer for 16 mins, flipping half way.
Whilst cooking, combine all the sauce ingredients.
Once the chicken is done begin to heat and reduce the sauce slightly.
Add your chicken to the pan and coat in the sauce.
Garnish with sesame and spring onion.
Enjoy😋

quick easy fakeaway better than takeout low calorie high protein sweet spicy post work gym dinner meal".

audio.transcript: This Korean popcorn chicken is so easy, so good. It's perfectly sweet yet spicy, and the best part is it's made in the air fryer. The chicken is so crispy and we don't use any oil, so it helps keep the calories down. My favorite thing about this recipe is it comes together in under 30 minutes, so it's perfect for a weeknight meal or if you haven't bothered to cook. If you want to give it a try, the full recipe details are in the caption and follow for more delicious food like this.
